about:
REPOWER by Solar Universe Northeast PA, operating as REPOWER PA, is based in Mountain Top, Pennsylvania. The business traces its roots to 1988 when Tony and Susie Delldonna began a home construction company. In 2009 they added solar photovoltaic installation to their services, focusing on residential and small commercial projects.

The company designs, permits, and installs grid-tied solar PV systems for homes and businesses. Its crew handles site evaluation, system engineering, utility interconnection paperwork, and physical installation of roof-mounted or ground-mounted arrays. Projects referenced in customer reviews range from 10 kW to 12 kW installations using Enphase microinverters. The operation remains small, led by the Delldonnas with a field crew.

Customers are primarily homeowners in northeastern Pennsylvania and nearby commercial property owners seeking to reduce electricity costs. Testimonials cite installations in Jefferson Township and other local communities. The firm also retrofits existing arrays with new inverters and provides ongoing monitoring support.

The Delldonnas emphasize hands-on project management, guiding clients through incentive applications and bureaucratic hurdles. Reviews highlight their responsiveness, thorough documentation binders, and warranty follow‑up as reasons clients choose them over larger installers.
